About Rocket Youth:

Rocket Youth owns and operates a growing portfolio of youth sports, enrichment, and after-school businesses across the United States, with ~80 brands and locations today. Our platform is intentionally multi-brand and multi-location: each business keeps its own identity and its focus on the local community it serves.

We grow organically and through acquisition, partnering with founder-led businesses and the experienced local operators who run them day to day. As new businesses join, we bring them onto a shared platform while preserving what makes each one successful.

Rocket Youth supports its businesses with operational leadership and shared services, including marketing, CRM, analytics, technology, M&A, accounting, finance, HR, and capital, so local teams can focus on the children and families they serve.

Position Overview

The Payroll Manager is a hands-on leader who owns enterprise-wide payroll, payroll tax, and benefits administration for Rocket Youth’s growing portfolio of partner businesses. This role is the company’s subject-matter authority on multi-state payroll tax and employee benefits, ensuring that every employee across our multi-entity, multi-state structure is paid accurately, taxed correctly, and enrolled in the right benefits on time.

Operating in a high-growth, acquisition-driven environment, the Manager leads the payroll, tax, and benefits workstreams that bring newly partnered businesses onto the Rocket Youth platform, from state tax registration and first payroll through benefits transition and open enrollment. The Manager works in UKG every day as an expert user of its payroll, tax, and benefits functions, and partners with the Director of HRIS, who owns UKG system configuration, architecture, security, and integrations.

You will partner closely with HR, Finance and Accounting, M&A, benefits brokers and carriers, and partner leadership to deliver compliant, scalable, and audit-ready payroll and benefits operations.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll

  • Lead the payroll and benefits integration process for partnered firms.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure a smooth transition and alignment with company standards.

  • Oversee onboarding and initial set-up of new employees whether by single hire, or multi-person partnership.

  • Stay abreast of local, state, and federal regulations related to payroll and ensure compliance.

  • Oversee end-to-end payroll processing, including calculation, disbursement, and compliance for all entities within the consolidated structure.

  • Implement and maintain efficient payroll systems and tools to streamline processes.

  • Work with HRMS to set up new entities, new work locations, and other functions based on the details of new partnerships.

  • Audit and reconcile payroll and benefits earnings, deductions, and invoicing.

  • Work with the finance team to ensure GL reporting is accurate and up to date.

  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of payroll for all employees.

  • Prepare and maintain payroll reports for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to payroll processing systems.

  • Address payroll and benefit-related inquiries from employees promptly and professionally.

  • Collaborate with HR, Finance, IT, Compliance, Brokers, and other teams to ensure seamless integration of payroll processes with broader organizational functions.

  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation in payroll processes to support scalability.

  • Implement best practices to enhance accuracy and efficiency.

  • Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations related to payroll and benefits.

  • Generate accurate and timely reports for internal stakeholders and regulatory authorities.

  • Evaluate, select, and manage relationships with payroll and benefits service providers.

  • Negotiate contracts, monitor service levels, and optimize vendor performance.

Payroll Tax

  • Own multi-state payroll tax compliance under a single FEIN, including federal, state, and local income tax withholding, FUTA, and SUTA across all states and local jurisdictions where we have employees.

  • Register new entities and work locations with state and local tax agencies (withholding and unemployment accounts) ahead of each partner’s first payroll and set up tax accounts with UKG Payment Services in partnership with the Director of HRIS.

  • Oversee quarterly and annual tax filings and payments (Forms 941, 940, state withholding and unemployment returns, W-2 and W-2c).

  • Use the UKG Pro Tax Reconciliation tool to reconcile wages and liabilities every quarter and at year-end, and prepare and submit prior-quarter taxes and liabilities every quarter and at year-end, and prepare and submit prior-quarter adjustments (PQAs) through UKG Payment Services, including the amended filings and W-2c corrections that result.

  • Manage state unemployment rate notices and account maintenance and apply successor-employer and experience-transfer rules when businesses are acquired.

  • Advise HR, Finance, and M&A leadership on the tax impact of payroll transition timing, including wage-based restarts, mid-year EIN changes, duplicate W-2s, and over-withholding FICA and SUTA.

  • Apply multi-state taxability rules, including work-location and resident taxation, reciprocity agreements, and the taxability of fringe benefits and imputed income.

  • Research and resolve agency notices, penalties, and amended returns, and maintain audit-ready tax documentation.

UKG Strategy, Architecture & Transformation

  • Serve as system owner and leader for UKG (payroll, timekeeping)

  • Define and execute the long-term UKG roadmap, including scalability, integrations, and automation

  • Lead enterprise configuration strategy (pay rules, earnings codes, org structure, security, workflows)

  • Drive continuous improvement through system enhancements, releases, and feature adoption

M&A Integration & Scalability

  • Manage payroll integration strategy for acquisitions (10–15 per year)

  • Design repeatable, scalable onboarding frameworks for newly acquired entities

  • Oversee data migration, system configuration, compliance setup, and payroll readiness

  • Partner with M&A and operational leadership to ensure seamless transitions and minimal disruption

Data Governance, Analytics & Compliance

  • Establish enterprise data governance standards ensuring accuracy, integrity, and security

  • Develop reporting and analytics capabilities to support executive decision-making

  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local payroll regulations and data privacy laws

  • Lead internal/external audits and always maintain audit readiness

Qualifications Required

  • 10+ years of progressive payroll and Tax experience

  • 5+ years of deep UKG expertise (payroll, administration, integrations, reporting)

  • Proven experience in a multi-entity, multi-state environment

  • Experience operating in high-growth and/or acquisition-driven organizations

  • Strong knowledge of payroll compliance, tax regulations, and governance

Preferred

  • Experience leading UKG implementations, transformations, or large-scale integrations

  • M&A integration experience (highly preferred)

  • CPP (Certified Payroll Professional) or equivalent certification

  • Background in private equity-backed or roll-up environments

What Success Looks Like

  • Seamless payroll execution with zero compliance risk

  • Scalable UKG infrastructure supporting rapid acquisitions

  • Reduced manual processes through automation and system optimization

  • High-performing, self-sufficient payroll/HRIS team

Rocket Youth is an equal opportunity employer, considering all applicants for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by state or federal law.
